title: Gibbons calls in Pandolfi to brief on the Rockefeller Initiative

plain: In the 1990s, President Clinton's science adviser John Gibbons called in a government scientist named Ron Pandolfi to give a briefing on the Rockefeller Initiative, a push tied to the Rockefeller name to get the White House to look into UFO matters such as the 1947 Roswell crash in New Mexico. The researcher Grant Cameron tells this, saying "this has been established that Ron was called to do the briefing." It matters because it would place UFO questions inside the White House at the time.
